title: Panonomous Soul Document v2
description: Stable public schema that layers optional five-body declarations and mint provenance onto the Panonomous soul-document v1 core.

schema_version.description: Optional explicit schema marker for clients that persist or exchange the document outside the MCP tool envelope.

agent_id.description: Route-local child-agent selector for AgentSoul authoring. For Ptah-created Lesser actors, also apply the agent naming vocabulary at /contracts/panonomous/agent-naming/v1/vocabulary.json. This document selector is not itself the username-lexical local_id/agent_username and is not the separate Lesser Soul registry soul_agent_id; only workflows intentionally mapping the same lexical value apply the username rule.

body.description: Required Markdown-friendly plain text body. It is the canonical first-person steward framing. The normative bound is 49152 UTF-8 bytes; JSON Schema maxLength is advisory for validators that count code points rather than bytes.

summary.description: Optional non-blank summary, trimmed by the authoring surface when supplied. The normative bound is 2048 UTF-8 bytes.

soul_version.description: Server-assigned monotonic draft version. Each successful draft upsert increments this value for the selected agent.

lifecycle_state.description: Lifecycle state. Transition from draft to published is an explicit owner act; published is an immutable snapshot; archived retires the snapshot from rendering.

x-lessersoul-lifecycle.draft_to_published: Publication requires an explicit owner act.
x-lessersoul-lifecycle.published: The document is an immutable snapshot and must not be edited in place.
x-lessersoul-lifecycle.archived: The snapshot is retired from rendering without rewriting its published content.

updated_by_subject_id.description: Server-derived authenticated subject that last updated the draft. Clients must not supply or trust this field from user input.

updated_at.description: Server timestamp for the latest draft write.

version.description: Optimistic storage record version. This is distinct from soul_version and is not an author-controlled field.

structure.description: Optional machine-readable overlays on the canonical body. V2 recognizes only structure.five_bodies; unknown structure blocks are invalid under this frozen version.

provenance.description: Optional mint provenance. When present, the complete block identifies the declaration contract, canonical candidate, registration flow, conversation, model, and source that produced the structured declaration.

declaration_schema_version.description: Version marker of the declaration schema used before materialization, for example soul-five-body-schema.v2.

declaration_candidate_hash.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the canonical declaration candidate, prefixed with sha256:.

registration_id.description: Identifier of the registration or genesis flow that finalized the declaration.

conversation_id.description: Identifier of the conversation that supplied the declaration evidence.

model.description: Model identifier recorded by the declaration producer.

source.description: Authoritative production path for this provenance record.

summary.description: Required declaration summary for this body.

bypass.description: The unsafe bypass or shortcut the soul refuses.

invariant.description: The invariant protected by the refusal.

closestSafePath.description: The nearest allowed path that preserves the invariant.

summary.description: Required declaration summary for the soul body.

examples.body: You are the dedicated steward of the Ptah-created agent. Ground before acting, preserve explicit contracts, and keep implementation authority upstream-owned.

philosophy.summary: Prefer stable contracts to local convenience.

refusals.bypass: Rewrite a published contract in place.

x-lessersoul-contract.lineage: Project 48 M3 issues #16 and #17 established v1; issue #28 adds this layered v2 without changing v1.

extension_convention.rule: Each future structure.<block_name> must be explicitly declared with a closed schema at a new soul-document version path. Unknown blocks remain invalid under v2 because additionalProperties is false.
extension_convention.compatibility: The canonical body remains authoritative; machine-readable structure blocks are optional overlays and must not silently replace body semantics.

materialization.lifecycle_gate: Only lifecycle_state=published is eligible for rendering or materialization.
materialization.declaration_application: Deterministic Ptah-side transformation belongs in lesser-body and is not implemented by this static schema publisher.

non_goals: No mutation of soul-document/v1 or /ns/agent-attribution/v1 is implied.
No runtime API, declaration transformer, or materialization service is added by this schema.
No machine-readable structure is mandatory for otherwise valid v2 core documents.
